purpose: Longtail wave: first-class permanent Waiko / Boni / chime / taijitu ironman unlocks still missing depth after thin asgarnia:the-arc-waiko-shop and asgarnia:arc-skilling-access. Equilibrium packages The Arc under Asgarnia; Desert remains Ports gate support. Permanent account infrastructure only — no every-chime consumable, no cosmetic animation overrides (Ancestral Divination/Conversion), no island furniture cosmetics.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography (asgarnia for Arc packaging). required_regions lists hard gates; optional_pressure_regions are support only. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint. Use region_requirement_type support when Desert Ports pressure is soft.
policy.duplicate_guard: SKIP already first-class: asgarnia:the-arc-waiko-shop (thin hub — this pack deepens named children), asgarnia:arc-skilling-access, asgarnia:hunters-outfit, asgarnia:player-owned-ports-skilling-rewards, asgarnia:skilling-scrimshaw-package, asgarnia:port-sarim-skilling-hub, desert:player-owned-port, desert:scrimshaw-crafter, forinthry:bonecrusher, multi-region:toolbelt-bonecrusher-attach, cross-region:bonecrusher-necklace, forinthry:scroll-of-proficiency. Do not re-emit hunter outfit or generic POP scrimshaw lists.
skip_not_permanent_or_missing: Ancestral Divination I/II and Ancestral Conversion — cosmetic Divination animation overrides only
Death Lotus rogue / Gu ronin / Seasinger acolyte Waiko outfits — cosmetic overrides
Island customisations (deck chair, hammock, moai, house, etc.) — decorative only
XP lamps, teletab tablets as consumables, contract contact stacks — consumable sinks
Custom-fit trimming — not a Waiko Reward Shop permanent (not on Boni stock)
Soothing steam — not a Waiko Reward Shop permanent (not on Boni stock)
Hanto armour / Thalassia's Revenge / Rage of Hyu-Ji / Winds of Waiko — combat equipment, not skilling permanents
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent account unlocks, chime/taijitu sinks that change uncharted/contract throughput, and no-trade skilling infrastructure (grill, deposit box, claimed island, siphon blueprint, bonecrusher auto-pickup).
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour or chime/hour. Unlock costs, tier effects, and region pressure only.
policy.combo_fields: Every multi-region or support row sets region_hints, required_regions, optional_pressure_regions, region_requirement_type, and links_existing_ids.
